newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Air November load factor up.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Air November load factor up.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Inc said Monday its November passenger load factor rose 0.2 points to 67.4 percent from 67.2 percent a year-ago.
November's revenue passenger miles gained 4.6 percent to 5.00 billion from 4.78 billion, and available seat miles increased 4.4 percent to 7.42 billion from 7.11 billion.

Year to date, the load factor was up 1.5 points at 73.3 percent from 71.8 percent. Revenue passenger miles increased 9.9 percent to 63.14 billion from 57.43 billion, and available seat miles advanced 7.6 percent to 86.11 billion from 80.02 billion.
